name: Broad Net Internet Services
summary: Gold Coast dialup + ADSL ISP (Broadnet Pty Ltd); folded into Chariot (netconnect) c. 2007.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 18 Jan 2000 (broad.net.au); BROADNET PTY LTD trading name from 17 Mar 2000. Earliest capture 18 jan 2000.

Folded into Chariot (netconnect -> TPG). Retail broad.net.au homepage served Broad Net content through Dec 2006; from Feb 2007 the domain returned 301/302 redirects, and by Aug 2008 broad.net.au served Chariot's own homepage.
source: Wayback CDX: Broad Net 200 homepage through Dec 2006, redirects/Chariot content from 2007
